fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-04-27 at roughly 00:25, it was reported that a maroon motorcycle bearing registration number TN-45-XX-1060 was found missing from the parking space near Roja Layout Industrial Area. A witness, Abirami Sri, reachable on 9000000096, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint refers to Ganesh Shankar, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000155. The complaint mentions Pandian Thangaraj, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000427, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00021, as the mobile number 9000000427 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
